results.note: Epistola de Judaicis superstitionibus: searched multiple sources including Academia.edu, Fordham Medieval Sourcebook, and scholarly databases. No English translation found. Latin text available in Van Acker's Corpus Christianorum edition and Migne's Patrologia Latina vol. 104.
Carmina: searched for this work across major translation sources and medieval sourcebooks. No English translation located despite searching academic databases and CCEL.
Chartula ad Lotharium: no English translation found in searches of Academia.edu, Fordham Medieval Sourcebook, or comprehensive Agobard translation inventories.

Consultatio et supplicatio de baptismo Judaicorum mancipiorum: This work relates closely to 'De baptismo mancipiorum Iudaeorum,' translated by William L. North. North's translation available on Academia.edu and Fordham Medieval Sourcebook.
Contra objectiones Fredigisi abbatis: no English translation found in searches of major medieval translation databases or Agobard scholarship.

Contra praeceptum impium de baptismo Judaicorum mancipiorum: closely related to De baptismo mancipiorum Iudaeorum translated by William L. North, available on Academia.edu and Fordham Medieval Sourcebook.
De cavendo convictu et societate Judaica: translated by William L. North. Translation available on Academia.edu.
De comparatione regiminis ecclesiastici et politici: no English translation found despite searches in Academic.edu and medieval sourcebooks. Latin text available in Van Acker's edition.

De insolentia Judaeorum: translated by William L. North. Published in 'The Jew in the Medieval World: A Source Book, 315-1791' (Hebrew Union College Press, 2015) and available on Fordham Medieval Sourcebook.
De modo regiminis ecclesiastici: no English translation found in searches of Fordham Medieval Sourcebook, Academia.edu, or academic databases.
De privilegio et jure sacerdotii: no English translation located despite searches of major patristic translation sources.
Deploratoria de injustiis: likely same work or closely related to 'De iniusticiis,' translated by William L. North. Translation available on Academia.edu.
Epistola ad Bartholomeum de quorumdam inclusione signorum: possibly related to 'On the Deception of Certain Signs' translated by W.J. Lewis, available on Fordham Medieval Sourcebook.
Epistola ad Ebbonem de spe et timore: no English translation found in searches of Fordham Medieval Sourcebook or academic databases.
Flebilis epistola de divisione imperii: the fuller title of 'De divisione imperii,' translated by William L. North. Translation available on Fordham Medieval Sourcebook (dated ca. 830).
Liber adversum dogma Felicis Urgellensis: no English translation found despite searches mentioning this work in scholarly articles on Agobard and adoptionism.
Liber adversus legem Gundobadi: no English translation found in searches of Academia.edu, Fordham Medieval Sourcebook, or patristic translation databases.

Liber apologeticus pro filiis Ludovici Pii: Courtney M. Booker has translated Liber Apologeticus I and II (both parts of 833). Translations available on UBC website and Academia.edu. Booker's complete Agobard translation project is under contract with University of Toronto Press.
Liber contra Amalarium: no English translation found despite searches mentioning Agobard's controversy with Amalarius in scholarly works.
Liber contra judicium dei: no English translation found despite extensive searches. Latin text available on Wikisource. Work argues against trial by ordeal.
Liber de correctione antiphonarii: no English translation found in searches of Fordham Medieval Sourcebook or academic translation databases.
Liber de dispensatione ecclesiasticarum rerum: no English translation found despite searches of major medieval translation sources.
Liber de divina psalmodia: no English translation found in searches of Fordham Medieval Sourcebook or Academia.edu.
Liber de grandine et tonitruis: translated by W.J. Lewis (full translation, Academia.edu) and partial translation by P.E. Dutton in 'Carolingian Civilization: A Reader' (2nd ed., 2009, pp. 189-192).
Liber de imaginibus sanctorum: no English translation found despite searches of Fordham Medieval Sourcebook and academic databases.
Sermo de fidei veritate: no English translation found in searches of major medieval translation sources and Agobard scholarship databases.
